canonicalRequirements.statement: Bind the Owner-ratified GATE26 canonical mandate instrument by its exact SHA-256 5b02dc6628ca1874e0f60cbdf44823a1adc4b7c63d0428dfb78f3de16902b8b7 (16384 bytes). The mandate freezes PREDICTIVE ENSEMBLE ENGINE V1 design scope only and confers no execution, START, BUILD, ledger, commit or push authority.

This revision is PRECONTRACT ONLY. startAuthorized=false. ratificationIsNotStart=true. GATE26 remains NOT_STARTED. It authorizes no START, no BUILD, no ensemble computation and no lifecycle transition.
Reuse the GATE25 terminal dependency proof COMPLETE_CONFIRMED, bound by exact SHA-256. GATE25 is not re-audited and not reopened by this candidate.

GATE25 D1-D8, P3H 793/9 pinset, analogue index LFS identity e32c2e3de4ee6d88b80ed27fec4f29b930c02ce022477ce084f7ae4c768a4f0b, and GATE22 horizonsV1 30/90/180/252 remain frozen consumed inputs. This revision does not mutate them.

V1 family set, combination-without-weights, support-derived non-probability confidence, and fail-closed ABSTAIN remain as frozen in the mandate. Mini-build product implementation is reserved to a later successor revision and is not authorized here.

Mandate deferredToContract items remain unbound in this revision. Binding them is reserved to a later GATE26 contract succession before MINI_BUILD. GATE21 through GATE25 surfaces, P3H, analogue products, the status ledger, and ACTIVE_GATE stay unmodified by this candidate.

requiredOutputs.role: Pointer to the exact versioned contract

positiveTests.case: the candidate contract and pointer bytes validate against the canonical contract schema
every requiredInput binds its verified SHA-256 exactly, mandate instrument included
GATE26 remains NOT_STARTED and GATE25 remains COMPLETE_CONFIRMED

negativeTests.case: START, BUILD, ensemble computation or mini-build product write under this candidate
any write to a GATE21 through GATE25 surface, to P3H, or to the GATE25 analogue product
any write outside the three authorized contract paths

countertests.case: this candidate presented as PROJECT_OWNER_GATE_START_AUTHORITY or GATE_START_RECORD
this candidate presented as a consumed Owner START authority
mandate bytes changed after this binding

reuseRules: Reuse the GATE25 precontract cohort format and the existing GEE precontract primitives without modification.
Reuse the verified mandate and dependency SHA-256 values; do not reserialize or republish them.
Reuse GATE25 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED as the sole predecessor terminal proof.
invalidationRules: Any drift of a hash-pinned required input blocks this candidate.
Any loss of GATE25 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED blocks this candidate.
Any change of GATE26 away from NOT_STARTED blocks this candidate.
Any GATE21 through GATE25 mutation blocks this candidate.
Any binding of a deferredToContract item into this revision blocks this candidate.
closureConditions: This revision is PRECONTRACT ONLY. Publication of these bytes at the GATE26 contract paths is authorized solely by PRECONTRACT_BOOTSTRAP_GATE26_LOCAL_R1 under LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY.
This candidate is not closure, not confirmation, not START, not BUILD and not MINI_BUILD.
A later separately authorized lifecycle is required before START. This document creates no PROJECT_OWNER_GATE_START_AUTHORITY and no GATE_START_RECORD.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: No next-Gate authorization is created by this candidate.
No START authorization is created by this candidate.

checkpointPolicy.resume: GATE26 mandate Owner-ratified; PRECONTRACT bootstrap under PRECONTRACT_BOOTSTRAP_GATE26_LOCAL_R1; GATE26 NOT_STARTED
checkpointPolicy.reuse: GATE25 precontract cohort format and GEE precontract primitives
